title: Appeals and Grievances Case Type Catalogue
content:
**Appeals and Grievances** cases fall into six types, listed here in their order from the first to the sixth, each with the matter it is opened for and the subjects handled under it.

## What each case type is opened for

| No. | Case type | Opened for |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Member Grievance | Dissatisfaction other than an adverse benefit determination |
| 2 | Quality of Care Grievance | A quality of care or safety concern about a provider or facility |
| 3 | Standard Appeal | An adverse benefit determination whose notice is on record |
| 4 | Expedited Appeal | An adverse benefit determination where the standard timeframe could jeopardize the member's health |
| 5 | State Fair Hearing | A matter whose prior plan appeal was resolved upheld or is deemed exhausted |
| 6 | External Medical Review | A medical necessity dispute whose prior plan appeal was resolved upheld |

## Subjects handled under each case type

| Case type | Subjects |
|---|---|
| Member Grievance | Access to care; customer service; billing; transportation; pharmacy service; other |
| Quality of Care Grievance | Provider quality; facility quality; treatment outcome; safety |
| Standard Appeal | Prior authorization denial; claim denial; pharmacy exception denial; care management hours reduction; transportation denial |
| Expedited Appeal | Prior authorization denial; pharmacy exception denial; care management hours reduction |
| State Fair Hearing | Prior authorization denial; claim denial; pharmacy exception denial; care management hours reduction; transportation denial |
| External Medical Review | Prior authorization denial; pharmacy exception denial |

## Catalogue lookups (hypothetical subjects)

- A case about a **claim denial** is listed under Standard Appeal and State Fair Hearing; it is not listed under Expedited Appeal or External Medical Review.
- A case about a **transportation denial** is listed under Standard Appeal and State Fair Hearing, while dissatisfaction with **transportation** that is not an adverse benefit determination is a Member Grievance subject.
- A **safety** concern about a provider or facility is a Quality of Care Grievance subject.
- A **prior authorization denial** or a **pharmacy exception denial** is listed under all four of Standard Appeal, Expedited Appeal, State Fair Hearing and External Medical Review.
